svg.title: A Four-Person Base Pod, Expanded to Six
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-four-to-six-person-recovery-pod; chart type: org_architecture; title: A Four-Person Base Pod, Expanded to Six; subtitle: One owner, three contractors, and two clearly triggered expansion seats.; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Each node represents one person, not one full-time equivalent. Conservative and Base activate the first four seats: 1 FT + 3 C. Scaled activates all six: 2 FT + 4 C. Contractor hours and assignments vary with authorized workload.; caption: The owner coordinates economics and client delivery; retained counsel controls legal work within the agreed representation. Separate payment preparation from release wherever feasible.; stages: label: Owner and portfolio lead; value: One full-time owner leads intake, pricing, prioritization, and client accountability; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Active in every scenario. Own engagement terms, spending limits, fee forecasts, and exception resolution. Review prepared remittances against bank evidence and matter ledgers; owner net is the scenario's residual profit.; label: Lawful research contractor; value: One contractor documents assets, docket facts, ownership, and competing claims; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Active in every scenario. Use permitted public records and authorized databases, preserve source links, flag stale evidence, and escalate ambiguous identity matches. Do not select legal remedies or exceed data permissions.; label: Retained enforcement attorney; value: One contractor handles legal analysis, filings, and court-facing enforcement work; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Active in every scenario, subject to the actual engagement and required jurisdictional qualifications. Determine the client and representation scope, evaluate stays and exemptions, and perform reserved legal work independently.; label: Case and payment administrator; value: One contractor maintains deadlines, document completeness, and receipt reconciliation; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Active in every scenario. Maintain a shared matter register, monitor court notices, reconcile bank receipts, prepare creditor statements, and escalate missed events. Do not independently release funds that they prepared.; label: Scaled operations lead; value: One additional full-time employee coordinates the expanded active-file workload; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Activate only in the Scaled six-person model. Own capacity planning, document handoffs, aging reviews, and operational quality checks while the owner retains pricing and portfolio accountability.; label: Scaled data and quality contractor; value: One additional contractor tests automation and independently reviews matter records; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Activate only in the Scaled six-person model. Test deadline calculations against court rules, inspect duplicate payments and access logs, and sample lien evidence without replacing attorney review.
